description.value: A well-run riverside RV park on the edge of Stewart with glacier-capped peaks rising on all sides, offering cyclists clean showers, laundry, and a proper tent area — a natural stopping point for anyone riding the Cassiar toward Alaska, open May through September.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at bearriverrvpark.com corroborates the OSM phone number and address, and confirms dry/tent sites, coin-operated showers and laundry, WiFi, and a general store selling ice and snacks. A customer review explicitly mentions rental bikes available on site for riding to town. The business consistently self-identifies as 'Bear River RV Resort' on the website rather than 'Bear River RV Park' as recorded in OSM, which is flagged as a name mismatch concern.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Bear River RV Park' but the website consistently uses 'Bear River RV Resort' across all pages.
Seasonal operation (May–September per contact page); not available year-round.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established campground with tent sites, showers, laundry, on-site store, and rental bikes in a key touring location on the Stewart–Cassiar route; a clear and practical benefit to cycle tourists.
enrichment_extras.notes: A reviewer notes rental bikes available on site for cycling to town. Fire pit availability appears inconsistent across reviews — one says 'No Fire pits' while another notes 'fire pits upon request'; likely situation-dependent.

wow_evidence: coin-operated showers and laundry ... rental bikes available on site
